rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only completion recovery action needs an observable warning before a missed finish without early false triggers on valid finishes.
observable_information: Temporal similarity of rendered road pixels to the launch view; completion and progress are evaluation labels only.
allowed_action_or_state_change: This sensor-only diagnostic records a revisit signal and leaves the underlying pixel driver's actions unchanged.
expected_success_endpoint: Revisit signal at least fifteen decisions before failed 2:5205 termination and no signal earlier than fifteen decisions before either valid finish.
control: Unchanged original pixel student and selected stable-risk pixel driver on already consumed identities, compared to their recorded completion endpoints.
falsifier: No advance warning in the missed-finish run or a premature signal in either valid finish run.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Three unchanged diagnostic episodes: student 1:5200, selected control 2:5205 and student 2:5205.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic capped at 900 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no action modification, fresh competitive or external action.
